detailed_description: JSON Minifier is a browser-side JSON.parse and JSON.stringify helper. Paste JSON into the textarea, click Minify to parse it and output JSON.stringify(parsed) without indentation, or click Beautify to output JSON.stringify(parsed, null, 2). Load Sample fills a small example object, Clear resets input, output, errors, and stats, and Copy appears when output exists. After minifying, the page shows original length, minified length, and a simple saved percentage based on JavaScript string length. It does not support comments, JSON5, streaming parsing, syntax highlighting, error positions, validation options, base64 features, downloads, or guaranteed file-size savings.
usage_steps: Paste valid JSON into the input textarea or click Load Sample
Click Minify to parse the JSON and output compact JSON.stringify text
Click Beautify to format the parsed JSON with two-space indentation
Review the invalid JSON error if parsing fails
After minifying, read the original length, minified length, and saved percentage cards
Click Copy when output exists, or Clear to reset the tool
usage_examples: Compact a small JSON API sample before pasting it into a test request
Beautify minified JSON from a log line so it is easier to read
Use Load Sample to see the difference between minified and two-space formatted output
Check the simple saved percentage before copying compact JSON into a config field
